summary: Electra Battery Materials filed a Form 6-K furnishing an October 2, 2026 press release reporting routine quarterly capital markets activity rather than a special situation. Under its shareholder-approved Employee Share Purchase Program, employees bought 37,341 common shares in Q3 2026 at the five-day volume-weighted average price as of September 30, 2026, with matching shares acquired by the Company. Electra also granted 112,676 deferred share units to non-employee directors. Its at-the-market program with H.C. Wainwright, sized at up to US$25 million, generated roughly US$92,000 from 150,003 shares at a weighted price. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms are stated.
